name: Still Space
detailed_description:
Last signal: 72 hours ago

Our research facility on planet Texog went dark 3 days ago. Your mission is to investigate the blackout and secure the main power unit of the facility.

A sci-fi thriller

Due to the thick atmosphere of Texog and the upcoming storm, we will lose contact within a few hours. You'll need to find your own way to survive in these corridors full of dead terminals, hostile anomalies, and shadows that grow deeper the further you descend.

Use your resources wisely

Power is your lifeline. Route electricity to open doors, activate lights, power traps, or reroute it to something else. Every choice matters. Every system you bring online might save you… Or reveal something you didn’t want to see.

An action-packed Metroidvania

Unlock traversal tools, uncover shortcuts, and bring systems back from the brink. Discover this tight interconnected world heavily inspired by Hidden Deep, and filled with secrets, hazards, and rapidly escalating threats.

Inspired by genre-defining classics

If you enjoy the creeping dread of Dead Space, the isolation of Alien: Isolation, the resource tension of Five Nights at Freddy’s, the atmospheric unraveling of Among Us, the survival structure of Resident Evil, or the claustrophobic tension of Hidden Deep, this game is for you.

It channels the unease, environmental storytelling, and moment-to-moment decision-making of those games into a tightly woven, high-intensity Metroidvania experience.

Tactical 2D shooting. Tight platforming. Limited power.
If you’re going to survive, you’ll need more than ammo.

You’ll need a plan.

short_description: Still Space is a 2D action Metroidvania with resource management, circuit-based systems, and tactical gunfights. Explore a decaying research facility, restore power to key systems, and stay alive long enough to uncover what went wrong.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

content_descriptors.notes:
Players use firearms and sci-fi weapons to kill aliens or zombie-like creatures. There are signs of violence on the environment.
The game is set in a dark, abandoned lab with frequent encounters with scary aliens.
